Answer: F
Reason: The CT images demonstrate a right-sided pleural effusion and an anomalous vessel draining into the inferior vena cava/right atrium region (scimitar vein), which is characteristic of Scimitar syndrome (a congenital vascular anomaly). This condition often presents with a hypoplastic right lung and can be associated with leftward displacement of the heart, mimicking a "left second arc protrusion" or dextroposition on chest X-ray, without primary cardiomegaly.
